what_this_is: Measures the longest stretch of a clip with no speech, counting the whole clip (no section is exempt): from the start to the first word, between words, and from the last word to the end. Music-only stretches count. Reads a whisper transcript; refuses one with no speech.

payload.label: Find the longest dead-air stretch in a clip, by words and by audio energy (runs on your computer)
payload.job: Give a dead-air check the longest speech-free stretch of a whole clip
payload.description: Measures the longest dead-air stretch of a whole clip: a moment counts when its transcript has no speech OR its audio is quiet (the union of the two; whisper often runs its words across a silence). No section is exempt. Each stretch says which source flagged it. Reads a whisper transcript and the clip's audio; refuses a transcript with no speech.

transcript.description: The whisper transcript JSON file of the clip.

clip.description: The clip's audio as a file (16 kHz mono WAV works).

threshold_s.description: Stretches longer than this are counted (default 2.0).

output_schema.description: {"result": {longest_dead_air_s, stretches_over_threshold, threshold_s, stretches: [{at_s, s, flagged_by}]}} or {"error": ...}

invoke.say: This runs on the person's own computer.

provenance.source: whisper transcript segments and duration; quiet frames from measure_prosody.py's levels
